name: Cone of Vitriol
body:
School evocation [acid, water]; Level: sorcerer/wizard 7, witch 7

Components: V, S, M/DF (a piece of metal partially melted by acid)

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Range: 50 ft.

Area: Cone-shaped burst

Duration: Instantaneous

Saving Throw: Reflex half; Spell Resistance: yes

This spell creates a spray of incredibly corrosive acid, originating at your hand and extending outward in a cone. The acid deals 1d4 points of damage per caster level (maximum 20d4). In addition, up to 1d4 of those who fail their save must make a second save or they are affected as if by a rusting grasp spell. The caster determines one object or item carried by each target to be affected by the rusting grasp.
